parsed_output.target_actor_if_supported: Contracting authorities publishing procurement notices classified under CPV class 9261 (division 92) on TED
parsed_output.observed_need: The packet establishes only that contracting authorities published contract notices and contract award notices under CPV class 9261 with varying stated TOTAL_VALUE amounts at notice scope; it does not establish a problem, need, or dissatisfaction these authorities experience.
parsed_output.candidate_intervention_class: Not determinable from this packet; at most, a class of inquiry into procurement-facing activity for actors publishing notices under CPV 9261 could be scoped, but no intervention class is supported by the supplied statements.
parsed_output.hypothesis_statement: It is worth investigating whether contracting authorities that publish CPV-9261-classified contract notices and award notices on TED represent a buyer population with a recurring structural activity worth further characterisation -- but the supplied statements do not establish any need, gap, dissatisfaction, or willingness to pay that would justify a specific intervention, so no product- or feature-level hypothesis can be formed from this packet alone.
parsed_output.independence_status: Independence is UNKNOWN for 6 of 6 rows; this packet does not establish that its evidence rows are independent findings, and the row count must not be read as a count of independent observations.
parsed_output.reliability_status: All 6 rows are SCORABLE, meaning a reviewed reliability applies to each measurement; scoring-ready is not the same as scored, and no score exists for any row in this packet.
parsed_output.evidence_bound_reasoning_summary: The packet shows TED published contract notices and contract award notices under CPV class 9261 with differing TOTAL_VALUE figures at notice scope, in bounded cohorts of 2, 3, and 6 notices, with stated spreads between largest and smallest values (e.g. 15,658,679.12 EUR; 235,017 EUR; 86,827,200 EUR). This establishes that a bounded set of contracting authorities exist and that published values differ, i.e. buyer existence, economic value as published, and market activity in the classified scope. It does not establish need, recurrence by the same actor, willingness to pay, solution gaps, dissatisfaction, competitive supply, distribution channels, regulatory drivers, or feasibility of any intervention. TOTAL_VALUE includes options and renewals per BT-161 and may be lawfully withheld, so no proportion or trend may be computed. No actor-level problem is named.
